# Kyoto Spring Trip Overview
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg

A 4-day Kyoto plan for two adults, centered on temples, local food, and one lower-walking day. Dates are set for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-13**, with a total target of **$1,800 excluding international flights**.

# Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar.svg

| Day | Focus | Main Plan | Estimated Cost for 2 | Walking Level |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| Apr 10 | Higashiyama temples + old streets | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion dinner | $330 | Moderate |
| Apr 11 | Arashiyama nature + temples | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, river area, tofu lunch, sunset train back | $360 | Moderate |
| Apr 12 | Relaxed temple + food day | Fushimi Inari early, Nishiki Market, tea break, onsen or café afternoon | $300 | Light to moderate |
| Apr 13 | Zen gardens + departure buffer | Ryoan-ji, Kinkaku-ji, final lunch, souvenir stop | $240 | Moderate |

## Apr 10 — Higashiyama and Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Start at **Kiyomizu-dera** early to avoid crowds; walk down through **Sannenzaka** and **Ninenzaka**.
- Afternoon: Visit **Yasaka Shrine** and stroll through **Maruyama Park** and the edges of **Gion**.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Visit **Yasaka Shrine** and stroll through **Maruyama Park** and the edges of **Gion**, Kyoto, Japan
- Food: Try **yudofu**, **matcha sweets**, and a kaiseki-style dinner in Gion.
- Cost estimate: **$330**
  - Temple admissions and transit: $40
  - Lunch and snacks: $70
  - Dinner: $120
  - Coffee/tea and small purchases: $50
  - Local transport: $50

## Apr 11 — Arashiyama and Riverside Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji**.
- Afternoon: Walk the river area, then choose a slow lunch with **tofu** or **soba**.
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for a relaxed dinner and optional dessert stop.
- Food: Look for **yudofu**, **soba**, **tofu skin dishes**, and seasonal sweets.
- Cost estimate: **$360**
  - Temple admissions and local transit: $50
  - Lunch: $80
  - Dinner: $120
  - Tea/coffee/snacks: $40
  - Optional boat or scenic add-on: $70

## Apr 12 — Low-Walking Kyoto Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- Morning: Visit **Fushimi Inari Taisha** early, then keep the climb short by turning back after the main lower gates.
- Afternoon: Spend most of the day at **Nishiki Market** and nearby cafés, with a long seated break.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Spend most of the day at **Nishiki Market** and nearby cafés, with a long seated break, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Add an **onsen**, hotel bath time, or a quiet restaurant night to keep the day easy.
- Food: Sample **tamagoyaki**, **pickles**, **tofu snacks**, **yuba**, and **matcha desserts**.
- Cost estimate: **$300**
  - Transit and shrine entry: $20
  - Market food and lunch: $110
  - Relaxed dinner: $110
  - Café/onsen/other leisure: $60

## Apr 13 — Zen Gardens and Final Kyoto Meal
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- Morning: Visit **Ryoan-ji** for the rock garden, then continue to **Kinkaku-ji**.
- Afternoon: Leave time for a final shopping stop or a slow lunch before departure.
- Food: Do one last Kyoto specialty meal, such as **obanzai** or a seasonal set lunch.
- Cost estimate: **$240**
  - Admissions and transit: $40
  - Lunch: $90
  - Souvenirs: $60
  - Snacks and coffee: $50

# Budget Fit and Trip Notes
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg

- **Estimated total for 2 adults:** **$1,230**
- **Budget remaining:** **$570**
- This leaves room for a nicer dinner, a better hotel, extra temple admissions, or a day trip add-on while staying under **$1,800**.
- Spring in Kyoto can be busy, so booking dinners and hotels early is smart, especially around cherry blossom season.

# Spring Packing Checklist for Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/luggage.svg

- Light waterproof jacket or compact umbrella
- Layering tops: T-shirts, long-sleeve shirts, light sweater
- Comfortable walking shoes with good grip
- Socks that work well with temple visits and indoor shoes
- Small day bag or crossbody bag
- Portable charger and charging cable
- Reusable water bottle
- Sunscreen and lip balm
- Basic meds and blister care
- Travel adapter if needed for your devices
- Light scarf for cool mornings or evenings
- Any reservation confirmations and transit cards
